text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Hmm... What should I do...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong, you two? You've been 
conferring with each other for a while 
now...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Actually... we were selected as management 
staff for the upcoming community exchange 
event, so we were just brainstorming some 
ideas.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Lots of little kids are going to come on 
that day. I really want to capture all 
their hearts!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Huh, is that so! An event that'll make the 
kids happy, huh...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Say, could you wait just a little bit for 
me?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Ah, that's it! Paka Petit, right?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes. For instance, what if we did a puppet 
show with these little ones?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: "I'm sure it will make eve~ryone smile!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ah! Could that just now have been—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"With Dia-chan and Gran-chan working 
together, I'm sure it'll be a wonderful 
play!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I know! Let's cheer them on so they can 
do their absolute best! Ready, and... Go, 
go, go!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Incredible, it really feels like they're 
cheering me on! Energy is overflowing a 
hundred miles an hour♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, the children will surely be 
captivated by this. ...May I give it a try 
as well?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course! The trick is to have 
sharp, dynamic movements... If you'd like, 
shall I teach you?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, thank you so much! Yes please, 
Professor Ai♪

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: "Hello! Nice to meet you. I'm Almond Eye."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu, it's an honor to meet you! I'm 
Satono Diamond. Please call me Dia♪"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Good Mile-ing~! I'm Gran Alegria! Let's 
have tons of fun today~!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, looking great! With this, you'll 
definitely capture everyone's hearts.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"It's all thanks to Ai-senpai! I learned 
so much about delivering lines and moving 
the Paka Petit puppets!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes, your teaching and demonstrations are 
both so wonderful...! But how did you come 
to possess such incredible skill?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I'm curious too! Maybe there's some 
amazing reason behind it, like Ai-senpai 
usually has...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Like, maybe you're just so good with your 
hands that you mastered it right away!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Ai-senpai is great at cooking and sewing, 
too. Puppet shows might be a total piece 
of cake for her!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Or perhaps she underwent intense training 
in the past."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
She hates to lose, you see. I heard she 
once went through intense training just to 
win the World Puppet Theater 
Championship...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: So what's the real reason behind it?!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Right, as for why—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Because it's cute, that's why.

text_block_list.name: Dia & Gran
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Paka Petit is super cute, isn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
They're so fluffy, with those round little 
eyes! I've loved them ever since I was 
small♪

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I remember always playing while 
thinking, "I wish this little one could 
move and talk."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"So, wanting it to look even more real, I 
practiced a whole bunch! And then, you 
know what—I got this good at it!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
—Ahaha! Right? Paka Petit are just so 
cute!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I think it's very, very cute! —And 
that includes you, Ai-san♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was the day of the community exchange 
event. Hearing that there would be a 
puppet show, I made my way to the outdoor 
stage, where—
choice_data_list: Amazing! There are so many kids...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"This trip to Hokkaido became a wonderful 
memory for everyone—and they lived happily 
ever after♪"

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Wah, that's awesome! Hey hey, show me one 
more time~!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
That was wonderful, everyone's big cheers! 
Smiles in full bloom, indeed!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much, Eye-san. I never 
imagined you'd appear in the real event 
too!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I don't mind this at all! When it comes 
to Paka Petit plays, I'm more confident 
than anyone."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I don't mind this at all! When it comes 
to Paka Petit plays, I'm more confident 
than anyone."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Fufu, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"We've played together tons of times since 
we were little. After all, we're best 
friends♪"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! 200 miles of cuteness! With this, 
we could even put on a full-length Paka 
Petit play!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
My, I'm honored. ...Would you like to give 
it a try too, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
If it's tips you want, I can teach you. 
Though since it's you, Trainer, I might be 
just a little bit strict.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"I recommend it as well! Taking on new 
challenges really expands your world, 
after all♪"
